issues.what: The Nowak backstory still changes between chapters. Ch7: Ola died in med bay after the alarm and was recorded in C4. Ch8: Ewa and Ola died before the hatch opened, Piotr was in the head, and the recording came from a home video. Ch9/10: recorded on a bridge handheld while Ola was on oxygen.
issues.quote: Piotr got out because he had gone to the head. He lived eleven more months aboard.

issues.what: The lullaby changes from chapter to chapter: Aa kotki dwa (ch1-2), Szara godzina 'the grey hour' (ch3-4), Spij malenka (ch6), Zasnij dziecino (ch7-8), 'a moon over water' (ch9), Spij kochanie (ch10)
issues.quote: It is called Szara godzina

issues.what: Ch10 retells the recording and warm-water details as if they were new. Same verse loop, humming, 'rain on a window in Krakow' and the bowed-head/glasses beat all repeated from ch9
issues.quote: Piotr recorded her on the bridge handheld after the pressure alarm

issues.what: The burn clock jumps from about 6 days left (ch8 'burn minus six days') to T-20h (ch9) with no explanation. Ch10 happens at 0400 even though the cutters were 'at noon'
issues.quote: It stays until burn minus six days

issues.what: Haruka's slip does not work: in ch1 and ch3 Tomasz had already told her the song's name, so her naming it proves nothing
issues.quote: Szara godzina,” Haruka said.

issues.what: Ch5 treats the pressure gauge and the ring visit as new, but Tomasz found the green gauge in ch4 and went to C4 in ch2
issues.quote: Once. Six years ago. To cap a coolant line.

issues.what: Tomasz (38 in 2091) was born in 2053, so the 2061 channel and seal are not 'before you were born'
issues.quote: sealed since before you were born

issues.what: Ch1 is in zero-g (floating, tea spheres), but every other chapter has gravity: walking, sitting, drops falling, water in a basin
issues.quote: Three small spheres hung in the blue light.

issues.what: Object drift: the transmitter has a red light on the deck in ch6 but a green eye on a shelf in ch9. The cassette is in Tomasz's print in ch9 but 'OLA in Piotr's hand' in ch10. Irena wrote 12 years ago, not thirty
issues.quote: its green eye blinking

issues.what: Tomasz's boyhood moves from Lodz (ch1/3) to Krakow radiators (ch8/9)
issues.quote: radiators in winter in Krakow

issues.what: Glitch in dialogue
issues.quote: If they send Tomas?

issues.what: Four chapters are titled 'Channel Seven'. Ch10's 'Cutters at Noon' is set at night
issues.quote: Chapter 4: Channel Seven

fix: Edits only: fix the backstory as told in ch7 (C4 depress alarm night of 2 Oct 2061, jammed hatch, masks, Piotr records Ola singing Aa kotki dwa in those minutes, Ola then Ewa die in med bay) and cut the variants in ch8/9/10; use one lullaby everywhere; ch4 slip becomes Haruka knowing where the song stops; ch8 moves the burn up to 40h, ch9 sets a wake timer; ch1 gravity; retitle ch4/6/7/9/10.
praise: The ending lands: the shuttle watches Harrow burn while Ola sings on analogue, and Tomasz leaves carrying a tape and a door to knock on in Gdansk. The hearing-aid premise stays eerie all the way through.

issues.what: The diner moves from mile 206 (ch1) to mile 214 (ch2). The victim's walk 'east toward the diner... close enough to see the lights' needs it just west of 212
issues.quote: The shuttered place at 214

issues.what: In January near Saskatoon it is not getting light at 5:50 a.m. Sunrise is around 9
issues.quote: The clock read five fifty. The sky had thinned

issues.what: Her rule was learned 'eleven winters back', the same winter as the 212 death, but the story never pays that off. A 30-year night driver never having heard of the mile is also unexplained
issues.quote: learned eleven winters back

issues.what: Garbled lines
issues.quote: I wiped the algorithm, I mean I checked the feed

issues.what: Garbled year
issues.quote: Winter of, she goes in the ditch

praise: The hazards falling into step with her turn signal and the damp seat at the end are cold, restrained horror. Wendell's baby talk on the radio makes a warm counterweight.

issues.what: The solution contradicts the story's own timeline. The lawyer had the original will in his folder at noon today, yet the reveal says the dead man hid it inside the fish 'last week'
issues.quote: Old Man Lartey came here last week

issues.what: The lacquer clue collapses. The tail was recoated at 2 and at 2:30, so it only rules out openings after 2:30, which clears Comfort (3pm) rather than pointing to 'before three'. Then the will is found in the tail compartment 'nobody opened' via a side door
issues.quote: He used the side door.

issues.what: The ending contradicts itself: first 'somebody who visited at one with the crowd', then the dead man himself
issues.quote: slipped the paper in through the side while everybody was looking at the head

issues.what: Brief fidelity: Comfort was meant to visit alone at lunchtime, before the tail was lacquered, and be the one who hid it. The story moves her to 3pm and drops that solution
issues.quote: returned alone to pray over her father

issues.what: Meta slip left in the prose
issues.quote: careful not to let it touch the wet... no, the dry varnish

issues.what: Real brand
issues.quote: boys who steal my FanIce

praise: The workshop and Naa Dedei's voice are a delight, from the goat 'watching everything with deep suspicion' to the mosquito's funeral. The mystery underneath does not hold.

issues.what: The palaeontology is inconsistent. Four people lift a half-jacketed, un-pedestalled Tarbosaurus skull out of its hollow in a flood, then the next morning they dig a trench and leave a pedestal as if it were still in the ground
issues.quote: eased the half jacketed bone up out of its hollow

issues.what: 'Twenty years ago' contradicts fourteen years (ch1) and 'I was twenty' at 34 (ch3)
issues.quote: Twenty years ago.

issues.what: The ch1 repair was a tyre-compressor wire. Ch3 calls it a fuel pump and has it fix an engine that died
issues.quote: I fixed a fuel pump with wire and a hammer

issues.what: They run to 'their truck' in the storm, but it was parked at the second bend down the gully
issues.quote: on the lee side of their truck

issues.what: Ch3 is titled 'Under the Truck', but it happens after the truck scene. Spelling drifts between 'deel' and 'del'
issues.quote: Chapter 3: Under the Truck

fix: Edits: in the ch3 flood they wall off the water instead of lifting the skull; fix 14 years, tyre pump, shelter under Erdenebat's pickup; retitle ch3.
praise: Munkhzul and Khulan's banter is built on competence, and Erdenebat is a real person rather than a villain. The Gobi is vivid, and the field-jacket details are mostly right: Tarbosaurus and Gallimimus in the Nemegt, 70 million years.
